messages.text: Today best build, didn't update ? the last best build is v9 ?

Right: the official best build is still v9 (v9-final). The next one, v9.2, is being tested on the iPhone now and replaces it only if nothing gets worse.
| | v9-final (today's best) | v9.2 (in test) |
|---|---|---|
| contents | all fixes landed up to this morning, plus the menu that follows the finger | v9-final plus skipped scroll callbacks and the menu-close rule |
| Chrome: page work while scrolling | 289 per second | 187 per second |
| status | landed | iPhone test 1 of 9 runs done, about an hour left, then your blind swipe test |
- If v9.2 passes, I'll mark it the best build and tell you here; the menu clock (accepted today) comes next.
What you need to do: nothing now; do the swipe test when it appears in "Your steps".

v9-final stays today's best build: v9.2 did not pass its iPhone test, so it does not replace v9.
- A reviewer re-ran the scoring and confirmed it: 9 of 9 runs valid, but v9.2 had 3 frames over 50 ms in 4 fling-and-stop runs (a new build may have 0).
| | v9-final | v9.2 |
|---|---|---|
| nav blinks while flinging back | 0 | 6 |
| Chrome page work while scrolling | 289 per second | 187 per second |
- Caveat: v9.2's flings travelled farther back up the page than v9's, so part of the gap may be the path, not the build (seen in our data only).
- Next: v9.2's three changes get tested one at a time on the iPhone to find the culprit, after the menu clock test.
- The menu clock (accepted today) runs next on v9-final, right after the current pictures test.
What you need to do: nothing; the best-build page keeps showing v9-final.
